title: Fusion Cultural Fest 2027
objectives: Showcase student talent to the wider campus
resources: Venue booking, sound system and a volunteer team of 20 students

claims.claim_text: We anticipate around 346 attendees, a significant increase over earlier turnout, driven by stronger promotion.
We can deliver this Cultural Fest efficiently within INR 71,000, well below typical costs.
Our previous events were delivered on budget and received excellent participant feedback.
This event complies with all applicable university policies and approval requirements.
This event will become a flagship tradition for the university.
